title: bridge: RQ-APPCTL-7-AGENTCONTROL
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-APPCTL-7-AGENTCONTROL` (pool: codex-personal), single commit on base `16b5c5c43`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-APPCTL-7-AGENTCONTROL

Uncommitted implementation: `phm app` JSON commands, versioned loopback POST, and `phm_app_control` in the existing stdio bridge. Reuses fleet pause/resume and Verse preferences with dispatch, token and JSON gates. Existing read routes only. Private connection files separate read and mutation tokens. Textual or absent usage becomes `unknown`; response error bodies are suppressed.

RQ-AGENTNATIVE-phantom-DESKTOPPREFS done for Verse preferences. RQ-MACCU-1 owns computer automation. References bc-124196c5 and bc-a46f053b; no duplicate desktop implementation. This checkout does not contain #2788's fleet.mission.v1 projection. No commits, pushes, tags, publishes, .github edits or companion MCP tool calls.

## Verification

Final affected tests: 89 passed, 0 failed (6 app route/parser, 4 CLI/MCP, 37 preferences, 5 Fleet component, 37 lane-correction tests). Targeted ESLint, docs, verify-changed and both lint guards passed. NOT GREEN: native web typecheck failed in untouched files; full npm lint/typecheck still pending. No shippable/merge claim.

Commands run:
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: failed EPERM; existing CLI used.
- `phm docs --agent --json`, `phm mcp list --json`: passed. `phm wire status --json`: installed CLI rejected status (exit 2). No gateway config or auth changes.
- `npm run install:worktree`: passed, repaired incomplete ESLint dependencies.
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: passed; initial snapshot skipped missing ESLint and web typecheck before those changes, covered separately.
- `npm run typecheck`: backend passed; web pending. Retried after dependency repair. `node_modules/.bin/tsgo --noEmit -p src/web-ui/tsconfig.json`: failed (exit 1) on untouched notification fixtures (widened outcome strings), inbox approvalRequest types, publish-funnel fixture version types, and shell types. No diagnostics named this change.
- `npm run lint`: first failed missing ESLint module; retry running.
- `node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/cli/app.ts src/cli/help.ts src/core/web/app-control.ts src/core/web/api.ts src/core/verse/verse-mcp-stdio.ts src/web-ui/routes/control/fleet/FleetView.tsx test/app-control.test.ts test/app-control-cli.test.ts`: passed; final MCP test and lane entries also passed targeted ESLint.
- `npm run lint:realio-lane && npm run lint:verse-sync-io`: first guard found five existing unclassified subprocess tests; added accurate real-I/O membership with no assertion changes. Both guards then passed independently.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/changelog-current-version-01.test.ts test/fleet-bridge-install-01.test.ts test/fleet-guardian-exclusive-02-solx1.test.ts test/fleet-standby-verb-02.test.ts test/gitignore-routing-eval.test.ts`: 37 passed.
- `npm run check:docs`: passed three times, 0 errors. `git diff --check`: passed.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/app-control.test.ts test/verse-preferences.test.ts`: preferences 37 passed; initial route test failed from import timeout and an incorrect response double/call signature. Fixed without weakening assertions.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/app-control.test.ts`: final 6 passed, including authenticated preference write and 404/401/415/400 boundaries.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/app-control-cli.test.ts`: final 4 passed.
- `HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:web -- src/web-ui/routes/control/fleet/FleetView.test.tsx`: 5 passed.
- `npm run dev:web -- --host 127.0.0.1`, `npx --no-install playwright --version`, `node /tmp/app-control-screenshot.cjs`, `node /tmp/app-control-render.cjs`: Playwright 1.64.1; bundled Chromium absent, Chrome denied live loopback, static render succeeded.

Net text LOC: +300 / -3 = +297 including these notes; binary screenshot excluded.

## Draft PR body

Adds one CLI/API/MCP path for app pause, resume and existing preferences, with strict versioned input and inherited mutation guards. Adds CLI parity, input validation, safe output and route-boundary coverage. Fleet displays the CLI twins.

![Static Playwright web-ui equivalent](artifacts/app-control/fleet-cli.png)

Screenshot is a static equivalent with the CLI hint extracted from FleetView.tsx, not a live desktop capture. Chrome denied loopback navigation; no live readings are shown. A live screenshot remains desirable before a PR is opened.
</details>

body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-APPSTEER-8-STEERINPUT` (pool: claude), single commit on base `16b5c5c43`.

**Tests:** no test command

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# BRIDGE_NOTES: RQ-APPSTEER-8-STEERINPUT

## Summary
- `phm app steer --text <msg> [--json]` (new `src/cli/app.ts`, thin) delegates to
  `src/core/fleet/app-steer.ts`, which sends one message through the shared channel
  receiver (channel `cli`, sender fixed to the local operator). That is the same inbox
  and agent-bus path as the web steer box (`POST /api/verse/fleet/runs/inbox`) and
  `phm comms inbox post`. The receiver scrubs secret shapes and dedupes. Exit 0/1/2.
- Fleet graph nodes: Steer and Hand off buttons now appear on every node (was only
  exhausted/held/stale). They open the existing interject dialog with a prepared line;
  readings are quoted as shown (usage number or `unknown`, no invented %).
  `liveNodeSteerVisible` removed as dead code.
- Docs: `docs/APP-STEER.md` (plain English, copy-paste example, exit table), entries in
  `AGENTS.md` and `llms.txt`, help and completions registered.
- Telegram/email/phone: unchanged; they reach the same inbox through their own
  authenticated bridges. No new channel added (nothing duplicated from bc-a46f053b or
  bc-124196c5).

## Not done (honest gaps)
- GUMLOOP "answer plain-English questions from fleet.mission.v1": that schema does not
  exist in this repo, so questions are delivered to the leaders like any message.
  Documented in docs/APP-STEER.md.
- PR screenshot: Playwright is not installed here and was not added as a dependency.
  Capture the Fleet graph "Seats and engines" list (Steer / Hand off buttons) manually.
- Pre-existing failure, not from this change: `test/doc-facts.test.ts` "every documented
  verb" flags `AGENTS.md:67` (`phm fleet lane-slots`), present on HEAD.
- Nothing committed or pushed.

## Commands run (HOME=temp dir)
- `npx vitest run test/app-steer.test.ts test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts test/cli-completions-subcommands.test.ts`: 3 files, 22 passed, 0 failed
- `npm run test:web -- src/web-ui/routes/verse/fleet-graph`: 10 files, 23 passed, 0 failed
- `npx vitest run test/doc-facts.test.ts`: 5 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing lane-slots line)
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .`: exit 0; `npx eslint` on touched files: clean; `npm run check:docs`: 0 errors

## Net LOC
Tracked files +44/-14; new files: app-steer.ts 29, app.ts 35, app-steer.test.ts 51,
APP-STEER.md 38. Net about +183.
</details>

title: bridge: RQ-NODE-4-VIEW
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-NODE-4-VIEW` (pool: claude), single commit on base `74fec5cf9`.

**Tests:** no test command

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# BRIDGE_NOTES — RQ-NODE-4-VIEW

## Summary
Nodes view: `phm nodes [--json] [--now <ISO>]`, `GET /api/nodes`, and a **Nodes** panel on the Fleet Dashboard (Mission Control view) showing role, caps, heartbeat age, live jobs, gh-auth state and a leader badge.

- `src/core/nodes/view.ts`: `phantom.nodes.v1` snapshot. Reads `~/.ashlr/nodes/<id>.json` (written by each node) and `leader-lease.json`; adds `local` from the daemon liveness proof. Strict allow-list parse; a record with a token-shaped string is dropped unread and reported by file name only. Sorted, injected clock, so deterministic. Every `problems[]` entry carries a `fix`.
- `src/core/nodes/age.ts`: browser-safe age formatter shared by CLI and panel.
- `src/cli/nodes.ts` (thin), wired in `index.ts`, `completions.ts`, `help.ts`.
- `docs/NODES-VIEW.md` (plain-English doc, copy-paste example), entries in `llms.txt`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/README.md`.
- No credentials read, copied or transmitted; each node reports only its own `ghAuth` state.

## Gaps to know
- NODES-1 registry, NODECAPS-14, failover v2.4 fleetlease and `fleet.mission.v1` (#2788) are NOT in this checkout. The view reads the node/lease files above and is the adapter point; record/lease file shapes are my proposal and need aligning when those land.
- No PR screenshot: no desktop app run here. Panel covered by a jsdom test only.
- No dead code found in the touched area to delete.

## Commands and results (temp HOME each)
- `vitest run test/nodes-view.test.ts` : 6 pass
- `vitest run --config vitest.config.web.ts src/web-ui/routes/fleet-dashboard` : 4 pass (2 new NodesPanel, 2 existing)
- `vitest run test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts test/agents-md-audit.test.ts` : pass
- `vitest run test/doc-facts.test.ts` : 1 fail, pre-existing and untouched (`AGENTS.md:68 phm fleet lane-slots`); all nodes lines pass
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (backend) : clean
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` : PASS file selection, tsc, realio lint, sync-I/O lint; FAIL web typecheck on pre-existing errors in unrelated `src/web-ui/routes/verse/**` files (none in changed files)
- `npm run check:docs` : 0 errors
- `npx eslint` : could not run (node_modules eslint install broken: Cannot find module '../lib/cli')

## Net LOC
+534 -1 across 19 files (git diff --shortstat, including docs, tests, fixtures).
</details>
